children: Binance announced on X that users should remain alert to private messages promoting investment opportunities that claim to guarantee profits or cannot lose money. The warning said such approaches may be part of common social engineering scams, in which fraudsters try to exploit trust and fear of missing out to influence investment decisions. Binance said users should be cautious if someone promises returns, urges immediate action, or asks them to move trading outside the platform. In those cases, users should stop the activity and treat the message as suspicious. The notice focused on helping users recognize common scam tactics and reduce the risk of falling victim to deceptive investment pitches. It did not mention any specific asset, service, or platform change, but instead emphasized careful review of unsolicited messages and pressure-based requests. Binance said the behavior described may be used to build trust before attempting to persuade users to transfer funds or make decisions under urgency. The announcement was framed as a general security reminder for users who may encounter these messages in direct communications.

title: Binance Warns Users About Social Engineering Investment Scams
